name: Marble Rumble Arena
author: mrhacwer
description:
I created this small game using Unity Learn Program assets of the Junior Programmer pathway and decided to share it because I added more things to it than the course required. It turned out quite well, and I’m really proud of it. I hope everyone enjoys it too.

Move - WASD
Escape - Main Menu
HoldSpace - When you have PowerUp (⚡) special Effect.
PressSpace - When you have PowerUp (🌟) special Effect.
